name: EPIC 211315053
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 15.8 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211315053 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.764069 (16th-84th percentiles 14.954229-16.778952), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211315053: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4487.9214 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211315053 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3008.164062 (16th-84th percentiles 2881.757812-3153.671875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,008 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.96 solar masses and 15.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,488 K at its surface.
